input_scope: Only seed_42_fold_{0..4}/oof_predictions.npz, the label-free group/sample_hash arrays from sealed_group_cv.npz, and split_manifest.json group-role metadata; no evaluation predictions, evaluation labels, retraining, or model selection.
delta: 1[h_temporal != y] - 1[h_equal_average != y], values {-1,0,+1}; C=delta +1 and D=delta -1
aggregation: Per outer fold and train-role group, then pooled row-count summary; no fold selection.
independence_note: Five train OOF folds share source groups and are not five independent tests; report overlap explicitly.
stop_or_interpretation: Use support to distinguish combination complementarity from call-before routing opportunity; zero damage is not a safety guarantee.
